definitions.explanation: The ability to read and understand written text.

examples.japanese: {読解力|どっかいりょく}を{鍛|きた}える。
{読解力|どっかいりょく}のテストで{高|たか}い{点|てん}を{取|と}った。
examples.english: I scored high on the reading comprehension test.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもの{読解力|どっかいりょく}を{伸|の}ばすには{読書|どくしょ}が{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: Reading is important to develop children's reading comprehension.

notes:
{読解力|どっかいりょく} refers to the ability to understand written texts. It is a key skill tested in language exams and important for academic success.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {読解力|どっかいりょく}を{高|たか}める (to improve reading comprehension)
- {読解力|どっかいりょく}テスト (reading comprehension test)
- {読解力|どっかいりょく}の{向上|こうじょう} (improvement in reading ability)

RELATED SKILLS:
- {語彙力|ごいりょく} (vocabulary ability)
- {聴解力|ちょうかいりょく} (listening comprehension)
- {表現力|ひょうげんりょく} (expressive ability)
